description: This PHP class 'OA_Dal_PasswordRecovery' handles password recovery operations for the Openads component of Revive Adserver, including user search, recovery ID generation, retrieval by recovery ID, and password update.

classes.name: OA_Dal_PasswordRecovery
classes.description: Data Access Layer class for handling password recovery processes, including user search, recovery ID generation, and password updates.

methods.name: searchMatchingUsers
methods.description: Searches for users with a specific email address.

methods.name: searchUsersByIds
methods.description: Retrieves users by their IDs, optionally filtering out new users with non-empty passwords.

methods.name: generateRecoveryId
methods.description: Generates a unique recovery ID for a user and stores it in the database.

methods.name: getUserFromRecoveryId
methods.description: Retrieves user data associated with a specific recovery ID, considering password update recency.

methods.name: saveNewPasswordAndLogin
methods.description: Sets a new password for a user and initiates login session.
